The test image shows tomato leaves with a distinct mosaic/mottled pattern of alternating light and dark green patches across the leaf surface. No discrete spots, necrotic lesions, or powdery coating visible. This is a **leaf** symptom.

Leaf candidates from the part index: Bacterial_Canker_And_Wilt_Of_Tomato, Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato, Cucumber_Mosaic_Virus, Early_Blight, Gray_Mold, Late_Blight, Leaf_Mold, Powdery_Mildew, Septoria_Leaf_Blotch, Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus, Verticillium_Wilt.

The mosaic pattern strongly suggests Cucumber_Mosaic_Virus. Let me view reference images across 8 classes to confirm.
CMV reference shows mosaic pattern with leaf curling/distortion. The test image has similar mottling but less leaf distortion. Let me check other candidates.
Powdery mildew shows discrete yellow spots with white powdery patches. The test image lacks white powder and has a more diffuse mosaic pattern. Not a match.
Leaf Mold shows yellow patches with potential olive mold on underside. Somewhat similar mottling but more localized yellowing rather than the diffuse mosaic in the test image.
TSWV shows bronzing with distinct necrotic spots. The test image has no bronzing or necrotic spots. Not a match.
Verticillium Wilt shows wilting with V-shaped browning. Not a match.
Early Blight shows dark brown lesions with concentric rings. Completely different from the test image.

Septoria shows small dark spots on yellowing leaves. Not a match.

Let me use my final view to confirm CMV with a whole-plant reference showing similar mottling.

All 8 views used. Summary of comparison:

| Class | Match? | Key difference from test image |
|---|---|---|
| Cucumber_Mosaic_Virus | **Strong match** | Same light/dark green mosaic mottling |
| Powdery_Mildew | No | White powdery coating, discrete spots |
| Leaf_Mold | No | Localized yellow spots, olive mold underneath |
| Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus | No | Bronzing, necrotic spots |
| Verticillium_Wilt | No | Wilting, V-shaped browning |
| Early_Blight | No | Dark brown lesions, concentric rings |
| Septoria_Leaf_Blotch | No | Small dark spots |
| CMV whole-plant | Consistent | Shows stunted plants typical of CMV |

The test image shows the hallmark symptom of Cucumber Mosaic Virus: a diffuse alternating light and dark green mosaic pattern across the leaf surface, with no discrete lesions, no necrotic spots, no powdery coating, and no wilting. The CMV leaf reference image (Bugwood_1) shows the same type of mottled mosaic pattern.
